Our approach

We help clients understand their obligations, evaluate the tax implications of transactions and prepare for compliance. Our partners bring direct involvement to complex matters and representations.

How is the scope of an engagement determined?

Services are agreed based on your requirements, applicable professional standards and the circumstances of the matter. Contact the firm to discuss the relevant scope and documentation.

Can related practice areas be combined?

Yes. Depending on the engagement, our partners can coordinate accounting, tax, assurance and advisory expertise, subject to applicable independence and professional requirements.
